bead.title: harness: machine-checkable capability matrix with evidence-ID bindings + CI gate
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. concerns.md §Harness capability matrix requires every harness capability to be declared in a machine-checkable matrix (one of required/supported/unsupported/experimental), with evidence IDs binding each 'supported' row to a real integration test or recorded cassette, and CI failing when a 'supported' row lacks evidence. Today only docs/helix/02-design/primary-harness-capability-baseline.md exists (human-readable). Either implement capability_matrix.go (generator) or capability_matrix.json (data file consumed by a test).

Source review: fizeau-d60b1694.
bead.acceptance:
1) A capability matrix lives under internal/harnesses/ (or docs/) as a structured artifact parseable by a Go test.
2) A go test asserts: every capability declared 'supported' has a non-empty evidence list, every evidence reference resolves (test name exists, or cassette file exists), every harness's emitted SupportedLimitIDs/SupportedAliases matches the matrix entries.
3) The CI workflow (or lefthook pre-push) runs this test.
4) Failure mode: matrix says supported but evidence is missing -> CI fails with actionable message.
